title: Support nominal (categorical) data on both axes for Line/Bar/Area, or a dedicated Heatmap mark

complexity.rationale: Confirmed structural: every mark's setScales routes the metric/value axis through addMetricScale (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/scale/scaleSpecBuilder.ts:117-126), which hardcodes `getScaleIndexByType(scales, 'linear', metricAxis, ...)` — the metric axis can never become a 'band'/nominal scale, only the dimension axis can (via addContinuousDimensionScale / Bar's dimensionScaleType: 'band'). The identical hardcoding exists in vega-spec-builder-s2/src/scale/scaleSpecBuilder.ts:124. Making the metric axis nominal would require rethinking position encoding, tooltip/voronoi hover targeting, and axis rendering across Line/Bar/Area simultaneously — or building an entirely new mark type (Heatmap) with grid-cell positioning and value-as-color/size encoding instead of value-as-position. Both paths are unprecedented, multi-site, and mutually exclusive design directions with a genuinely open question of which to pursue => 5.

summary: Line, Bar, and Area all force the metric/value axis through a linear scale (addMetricScale in packages/vega-spec-builder/src/scale/scaleSpecBuilder.ts:117-126, hardcoded to type 'linear'); only the dimension axis can be categorical ('band'/'point'/'time'). This is chosen as chartType 'chart' rather than a single mark because the schema's chartType enum has no value that spans all three affected marks (area/bar/line) — see openQuestions for the alternative of a dedicated Heatmap mark instead of extending the existing three.
requirements: Decide between two mutually exclusive directions (captured as an open question, not settled here): (a) extend Line/Bar/Area's metric axis to optionally accept a nominal/band scale, or (b) build a dedicated Heatmap mark type with grid-cell (row/column) positioning and value encoded via color or size instead of position.

If pursuing (a): modify addMetricScale (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/scale/scaleSpecBuilder.ts:117-126) to accept a nominal scale type for the metric axis, and update every downstream consumer of the metric position (mark position encodes, tooltip/voronoi hover targeting, axis rendering, hover point placement) that currently assumes a continuous numeric position.
If pursuing (a): apply the identical change to vega-spec-builder-s2/src/scale/scaleSpecBuilder.ts:124, which has the same hardcoded 'linear' metric scale.
If pursuing (b) instead: treat this as a new-mark-type effort scoped by a separate spec (see openQuestions), not folded into this one.

edgeCases.case: Both axes nominal with a very large number of distinct category values on one or both axes
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Grid/cell sizing must degrade gracefully (e.g. via scroll, truncation, or minimum cell size) rather than compressing labels unreadably.

edgeCases.case: Mixed nominal-metric and continuous-metric marks in the same Chart (e.g. a Line with nominal metric next to a Bar with linear metric)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Each mark's own scale should resolve independently; a shared metric axis across mixed scale types is likely unsupported and should fail clearly rather than silently mis-render.
Whichever direction is chosen, vega-spec-builder-s2 has the identical current limitation and needs the same fix.

edgeCases.case: Accessibility (screen reader / keyboard) for a grid-style chart
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Cell-based navigation needs its own accessible description pattern, distinct from the existing point/bar tooltip narration.

crossCutting.notes: touchesTooltipOrPopover: a nominal metric axis changes how the voronoi hover overlay and tooltip positioning work today, since both assume a continuous y position for hit-testing. requiresNewSignalOrScale: making the metric axis nominal is precisely a new (currently unsupported) scale configuration — addMetricScale never emits a 'band' scale today. requiresS1S2Parity: the hardcoded 'linear' metric scale is identical in vega-spec-builder-s2/src/scale/scaleSpecBuilder.ts:124.

implementationPlan.change: addMetricScale currently hardcodes a 'linear' scale type for the metric axis; this is the structural chokepoint that would need to change to support a nominal metric axis.
Identical hardcoded 'linear' metric scale as s1; same chokepoint.
setScales calls addMetricScale for the y/metric axis; would need to conditionally route to a band scale.

Bar already uses a 'band' scale for its dimension axis; investigate whether its metric axis could reuse the same band-scale machinery for a nominal metric, or whether Bar's dodge/stack logic assumes a continuous metric.
Area's y/y2 encodes (areaSpecBuilder.ts:320,346,410-411) assume a continuous 'yLinear' scale field; would need rework if metric becomes nominal.

openQuestions: Should this be solved by extending Line/Bar/Area's metric axis to support a nominal/band scale, or by building a dedicated Heatmap mark type instead (grid-cell position with value-as-color/size)? The issue itself raises the Heatmap alternative as equally legitimate, and it may turn out to be the better-scoped path — that decision should be made before implementation begins, likely via a separate follow-up spec if Heatmap is chosen.
If a dedicated Heatmap mark is chosen instead, planning/specs/schema.json's chartType enum currently has no 'heatmap' value and would need one added in the implementation PR.
